unit.why: A teaching that the tsaddik feels in his body the shifts between judgment and mercy, followed by a brief anecdote: the Rav of Apta told how in his childhood his limbs began telling him the future and he asked God to remove this gift.

stories.summary_en: A tsaddik says he is sick and sad when judgments hang over Israel and healthy and joyful in times of mercy; the Rav of Apta tells him that as a child his limbs foretold the future to him and he prayed to God to take this away.

tags.why: Mostly a teaching on the tsaddik's bodily sensitivity, with only a minimal anecdote.
